response.executive_summary:
The Department of Defense / Department of the Navy 
- Naval Surface Warfare Center Indian Head Division (NSWC IHD)'s mission to protect our nation requires thorough background investigations for personnel.

We understand NSWC IHD needs SWFT fingerprint collection services for up to 900 personnel per year.

Our approach delivers electronic fingerprint capture using Live Scan equipment at existing contractor locations nationwide.

Dee Davis Inc. is an EDWOSB certified small business with active SAM.gov registration and CAGE code 8UMX3.

We manage service contracts through vetted subcontractor partnerships who maintain active SWFT certification through DCSA.

Our network provides nationwide coverage with web-based scheduling systems in accordance with OPM standards.

We're confident that our approach will maintain rejection rates below 2% for all electronic fingerprint submissions.

This proposal demonstrates our commitment to NSWC IHD's strategic goals for solicitation N0017426Q1009.
